rule: clash.json from forum_clash_stats outputs: per (type, family, slot) the union setups (the planner's EV_CLASH premise on the recordings: the enemy's attack meets the swing's clash reach first, or reaches the inflated hurtbox while the swing is out; a contact setup alone misses the clashes that kept the attack off the hurtbox) in the family's clashable states (clash_states: the Control states its clashes happened in, at least min_state_clashes and min_state_share of the family's; the planner clashes only a contact that can come from one of them), a side or wall slash only with the enemy in front, up / down whatever the horizontal side, both crests pooled (the rule conditions on the window, which is where the crests differ; by_crest: each crest's own counts and bounds), p_clash_lb = the Wilson 95 % lower bound of clash / n (the branch's weight: "neither" is not a clash), p_fail = the upper bound of hit / n, both at n_eff = the attack instances behind the setups; keys with n_eff < min_n, the NEVER types / families, the body-only families and the families never clashed are left out (= not clashable).
